descriptionChirho: The proper noun Arpachshad (אַרְפַּכְשַׁד), a son of Shem and ancestor in the line from Noah to Abraham, appearing in genealogical lists in Genesis 10-11 and 1 Chronicles 1. Multilingual evidence uniformly identifies a single person: eng 'Arpachshad', spa 'Arfaxad/Arpajsad', hin 'अरपकशद/अर्पक्षद', arb 'أَرْفَكْشَاد', kor '아르박삿', swa 'Arpakshadi'. The two clusters represent minor transliteration and conjunctive variations across parallel genealogical passages, with no semantic distinction between the referent.
